descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Algebra (Modelling) — Mathematical Modelling for Real-Life Town Situations (C4)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-2 unit on mathematical modelling (C4) framed around 'Math in My Town' — Mayor Mira the Math Mayor and Town Tom. Children walk through the 5-step modelling cycle for town-scale situations: library, park, bus stop, school, store.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Town Modellers. Day 1 introduces town situations and math questions (C4 step 1). Day 2 collects town data — counts, measurements, observations (C4 step 2). Day 3 predicts town outcomes using simple rules (C4 step 3). Day 4 reflects and refines models with real numbers (C4 step 4). Day 5 closes with child-chosen capstone projects modelling situations from their own town life. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough covering Grade-2 misconceptions in modelling.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: town map, data charts (6), modelling cycle chart, town situation cards (12), prediction chart, capstone template, two-colour counters, number line to 100, mayor's modelling chart, town poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Mayor Mira and Town Tom
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 single-row summative rubric covering C4 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 capstone
Junior Town Modeller certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers covering the C4 cluster — mathematical modelling for real-life situations.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. The town map and modelling cycle chart are the anchors — children walk through the 5 steps physically. Lesson 1 conceptualises situations and questions. Lesson 2 collects data. Lesson 3 predicts. Lesson 4 reflects and refines. Lesson 5 closes with child-chosen capstone projects modelled on situations from their own town life.
